batting.dismissal: c RK Singh b K Khejroliya

batting.name: N Jagadeesan
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b TU Deshpande

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b RA Jadeja

batting.name: UT Yadav

balls.text: connects this time with a thump through the line to long-off, he wants two, he gets two... and that is the highest T20 score at Eden Gardens
Free Hit. Wide line, and gives it the big wind-up... but can't connect! Too pumped up?
Has a big swing, full toss outside off, but can't connect... but Dhoni is reviewing for the waist-high no-ball And I think he's got a point... No-ball it is! Oh rapture!

another full toss, and holes out to deep square leg! It's the biggest roar of the night... because look who's padded up in the dug-out...  but the umpire is checking for the no-ball... this could be scenes if Kolkata is denied its glimpse of Dhoni! Below waist height! Ecstacy in the stands!
another low full toss, another smoke off the toes! Jaddu clears the front leg, and muscles it hard through midwicket again!
thumped down the ground to long-on, and back for the second
Jaddu joins the fun! Low full-toss, just missed the yorker, and after a few sighters, this one pinged through wide long-on!
carved gleefully through point! Pace on the ball, pushed across his bows, met with superb timing and an open face!
more power in this one! Clears the front leg, greets the extra flight with a massive mow towards the prize car, just misses it!
effortless elegance! Who needs dinks when you've got traditional long-levered timing through the line? Unfurls a launch over long-off
nearly loses his off stump! Another reverse-sweep/scoop, but overbalanced this time as the angle beat him
swing across the line again, still not timing it, but another single to the on-side

a lusty swing across the line from Jaddu, doesn't time it as Roy rushes round to gather and Roy is hurt! Looks like his quad has pinged as he braked inside the rope. He kicks the sponge in frustration as he leaves the field... big blow to KKR
dinky Jinks! Preposterous timing, as Rahane inverts his hands, flicks the full length outside off, like a screwdriver to remove the top of a can of paint, and away through deep third!
low full toss, thumps the pad on the angle into leg stump, they take the single for a deflection to cover
good tight line, angled in on a yorker length, and beats a slightly flat-footed drive as Jaddu tries to find his range

the fun's over this time! Another firm strike through the line, planting the front foot, and crashing hard towards long-off... it was clearing the ropes, but it couldn't clear Roy, right back on the boundary's edge
swivelled magnificently over square leg! A 20-ball fifty for Dube, and that's a stunning bit of extension through the stroke. Full unfurling of those endless forearms!
flapped on the up to the on-side, gathered in the deep
swings up into the pull, gets a solid connection through backward square, and that's a 24-ball fifty for a very jinky Ajinkya!
full toss again, but dipping on the pads, tucked to the leg side
another leg-side wide as Russell slides a full-toss past the pads
on the back foot, cracked out to deep point
worked off the toes, out to deep fine leg
fired past the legs. Reload
deposited with a sweet, sweet report of willow! Length ball from Russell, lifting off the deck for Rahane to hoist up into the stroke with disdain! High over deep midwicket
back of a length, muscular areas from Russell as he hits the pitch hard, a mistimed slap ends up at long-off
strides to the wide line, drilled hard anong the ground to deep cover. A relative lull as Sharma ends his spell well
reverses the hands, paddles another single on the sweep to backward point
cracked off the back foot, down to long-off. It's all gone a bit quiet for ... two balls
another mighty wind-up, another air shot as the googly slips by into the keeper's gloves
huge! Looped up, into the blockhole, and absolutely blatted up into the night sky! High through the line, over long-on!
googly, can't connect on the slap this time
lamped hard to long-off. Another sliding stop, Dube is smoking them so hard he is earning himself a new spelling
more fierce leverage through the covers! That is travelling hard and fast, and it takes a good brave sprawl at deep extra to cut off the four. The fifty partnership comes up off 16 balls!
back of a length, opens the face, a firm steer eludes point but a bit of miscommunication as Rahane looked for the second to deep third
another cuff into the covers and this time just the single
rifled off the back foot through the covers! It's barely even the back foot to be fair, just a threat of weight transfer from an eagerly poised base, and there's no stopping it!
another muscular six over long-on! The 150 is up, and this has gone fast and flat, in the slot from round the wicket, angled into his rampant blade, and paying the price!
tapped to deep point to end a rowdy over with a moment of relative calm
another boundary, but rather less pretty! A good-length outswinger, takes a genuine nick off the drive, and away past the keeper
angled bat on the full toss, guided out to deep point
stunning cover drive! Four sixes in a row, but the four off the fifth ball is the best of the lot. Angles, placement, weight transfer, timing... chef's kiss
on the legs, and hoisted up and over fine leg! Sixes galore! Superb manipulation as Rahane walks across his crease to open up the option
Three sixes in a row! Over-pitched on the toes, but that needed some special timing to get it up and over deep backward square. Nailed off the full face, across the line and over the rope!

opens the stance, flings the blade! Dube causes the dug-out to indulge in a bit of Dubstep as a fast flat six scuds for their shins at long-on, but it hits the boundary sponge on the full to save them the carnage
round the wicket, and walloped into the stands! That's angles for you, angled in, belted off, high across the line and over deep midwicket
over the wicket, turning back into the right-hander on a tight angled line, blocked to cover
tight line again, skidding onto the bat as Dube angles a push to cover to get off the mark
tight line, back of a length, lamped off the back foot to point

open-faced drill to long-off! It was in Conway's slot, and he timed it well enough, but his direction was awry and Wiese barely needed to move on the edge of the rope. A fine knock, but it's over too soon for CSK's liking
on the back foot, sliding through flatter, guided to point
looking for the bottom-handed flip up and over the covers, but not quite timed as Sharma tweaks it away from the left-hander. Deep point tidies up
lots of air, dipping on middle and leg, an under-edged sweep ends up at backward square
sizzled through point! A fraction of width, and that's flamegrilled off the meat of the blade. Conway applauds with gusto at the far end
skips to the pitch, doesn't quite get there but goes through with the stroke anyway, flogged out to deep midwicket where two men converge to gather

full length, down on the sweep, thumps the pad, and they are going upstairs. It was definitely leg-sided but straightened. Did it pitch in line? There's no bat involved, so could be close if it did... indeed it did, but  Umpire's call on the leg bail! Very close!
up on the toes, chopped hard to deep point
full length, sliding onto the bat as Conway pushes to midwicket to bring up the 100
big appeal for caught-behind but nothing doing as Conway is beaten by some extra bounce
bottom-handed shovel clean through the gap at midwicket! Two men converge but leave it for the other as they nearly collide!
popped in the air, back to the bowler... who can't make the ground! That just looped tantalisingly off a miscued push, Chak flung himself forward but at best got his fingertips to the chance
launched with intent but doesn't get hold of it as long-on gathers
back of a length, extra bounce as the ball grips and turns away, flapped back past the bowler to complete a tidy over
open face, guided to the off side, Rahane calls urgently and through they rush for a fourth fifty in a row for Conway
wide line, but faster and fuller than Conway expected, and frustration exudes through the stump mic as he slaps to point
tapped to the on-side for another single... in fact they run well and make it back
back of a length, cuffed fiercely into the covers with an open stance but straight at short cover
clipped off the toes to the on-side, meeting the full length
scampers to the pitch and another big dent in Narine's figures! As soon as he got his feet in position, that was six all the way, an eager flog up into the stroke, high over wide long-on!
angled bat on the full length, a sharp single to point
flicked on the up to long-on, a better over so far
round the wicket, wide on the crease, angled in on a good length, poked back to the bowler
back of a length, a bit of grip on the back foot, flicked to midwicket
attempted helicopter clip down the ground, imparting some oomph from out of the blockhole, down to long-on
flat-batted in front of square! A fraction too short, Rahane rocks onto the back foot and slams his pull through the gap at wide long-on
guided off the back foot to the on side
back of a length, jabbed off the back foot into the covers, direct hit would have been tight... actually it would have been miles out!
sweet relief for KKR! That's a lovely bit of bowling, drift back into the batter, as the wrong'un grips and turns through the gate.  Gaikwad is confounded, but he's played his part
reverses the hands, can't connect on the sweep as the ball bobbles out to point
tight line on a full length, curling away, pressed back to the bowler

inside-out over extra cover! That's magnificent! What an end to the over, again, little fault with the ball, but Gaikwad read the turn away from the bat, opened his stance accordingly, and wristed it over the rope!
rocks back on the cut, and supreme placement! Not a lot wrong with the ball, just guided with timing after shuffling onto the back foot
tucked up on a leg-stump line, a touch of leading edge on the flick back to the bowler
slides into the pads, a firm press off the front foot rolls out towards long-on and they call for the second immediately
over the wicket to the right-hander, more tweak away from the bat, open-faced nudge to point
round the wicket, probing outside off with a hint of turn into the bat, pressed to point
pounds in the short ball, well directed as the batter sways inside the line. Powerplay done, and CSK well set
back of a length, long-levered launch out through midwicket
full toss, on the hip, might be a no-ball, but Gaikwad won't care either way... he's simply swung across the line, not timed, high on the bat, but lots of bottom hand take it clean over the rope
swings through the pull, up on his toes and hitting down on the stroke to backward square
too short on the wide line, and Conway cuffs the offering up and over a lone gully. Easy pickings
good areas to open his account, solidly pressed to the off-side
on the back foot, crunched into the covers but hits the field this time
wide line again, very solid timing on the cut, zipping in front of square to give deep point a fair bit of scurrying to scoop it up
pace off the ball, tighter line, cuffed out to deep point off the back foot
slapped through long-off! Not perfectly timed, a touch inside-edgy as he reaches the wide line, but got it past mid-off and after that there was no cutting it off
opens the face for a glided drive out to deep cover
panned across the line again! A touch too short, just outside off, that's all the invitation he needs to curl into a good position and pound the boundary
fenced off the hip out to the leg side
exceptional ball-striking! Skips to the pitch, feet in perfect synchronicity, and launching up through the stroke with such a clean straight blade, high over the sightscreen
hoisted across the line, down on one knee, clawing the slog-sweep to the deep square sweeper
full length and pushed back down the ground, tumbling stop
on the top of the wide line, chopped hard to point, can't find the gap
round the wicket, on the back foot, poked to cover with an open face
huge top-edge on the pull, but that's gone miles! Swings up into the short ball, beaten for pace a touch, but he got so far underneath his stroke that the willow did the rest!
that's Test match areas from Umesh, line and length and hitting the seam again, nipping away from the stumps and pressed cautiously to mid-off
inswinging into the blockhole, lovely tight bowling, clipped to safety, out to midwicket, a bit of a stutter in the run but home in good time
leaning into a slightly wider line, guided out to cover
zippy! Such a tight line across the left-hander, Conway looks for that short-arm flick over the leg-side but the ball seams past the off stump and through to the keeper
outswinger, just back of a length, tricky tight line and pressed with hands away from body into the covers
shortish and running away outside off, Conway opens the bat-face and guides it to point
too full and on the pads, Conway picks it up and dumps Wiese over square leg for the first six of the night
back of a length and angling into the stumps, Gaikwad punches a single down the ground

pitched-up delivery, angling across off, sort of stops on the pitch. Conway checks his drive and spoons it away to the left of the bowler. Wiese sticks his left hand out but the ball does not stick. Dropped but this was a difficult chance
hip-high short ball on leg stump, with fine leg inside the circle, Conway misses out on a scoring opportunity. He helps it straight to the infielder
dug in short and angling in at the top of off stump, Gaikwad hangs back and fends it towards midwicket
on a length and straightens away a touch outside off to go past Conway's outside edge. Good first over from Umesh
short and ducks back in at off, a crease-bound Gaikwad stabs an inside edge into the midwicket region
back of a length and nipping in to take the inside edge and roll away to square leg
shorter and swings away outside off, Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and punches to extra-cover
shorter and swerving into the top of off stump, blocked back down the pitch
Pitched up and outside off, hint of inswing, Gaikwad goes for a big drive and inside-edges it past leg stump for four
on-pace lifter outside off. Rinku slogs and misses
short and into the throat, gloved to fine leg
full-toss outside off, edged behind. Dhoni collects it. KKR think it's a no-ball and challenge it but the ball has dipped

slower ball, full and outside off, Rinku skies it away. Senapati, the sub for Rahane, tries to catch it but his foot is in contact with the ad cushion as he touches the ball. Parries it over the fence for six. Another fifty for Rinku
searches for a wide yorker. Comes out a low full-toss outside off. Rinku can't touch it
low full-toss outside off, under-edged behind to Dhoni who can't collect the ball cleanly
full-toss on middle, flapped to deep square leg. Rinku denies the single on offer and keeps strike
Theekshana drops a tough return catch and hurts himself in the process. Might have been the carrom ball. Stabbed back to the right of him. The ball bursts out
off-stump yorker, inside-edged to short fine leg

Caught at long-on. Conway dives forward from long-on and snags it. Good night for Conway. Good night for Theekshana. Another fast dart on the stumps, heaved in the air. There's the archer celebration again
seam-up ball? Back of a length and on leg stump, stabbed down to long-on
heaved to deep midwicket off the inner half

Gaikwad drops a skier at wide long-on. 111.6ks slower ball on off stump, Umesh slogs it hiiiiiiiigh into the night sky. Gaikwad shells it. There's a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Rinku is in
bouncer outside off, too high and wide called
mis-hit between deep midwicket and wide long-on
short and banged down the leg side, wide called
bangs it on a heavy length and it sails over the stumps as Umesh swings for the hills and misses

slower offcutter from Deshpande, 118.6ks, Wiese is early into the slog and misses. Not given out lbw. This is close and Dhoni has asked for a review of the on-field not-out decision. No bat involved. Ball-tracking suggests it would have hit leg stump. Dhoni gets it right once again
Rinku aims leg side, but checks his shot and slices it to deep point
Deshpande misses the yorker. Pitched-up delivery outside off, Rinku sizes it up and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for six
slower bouncer at the body, flapped away to long leg. What an over from Pathirana
slings in a low full-toss on off stump, jabbed down to long-off

The young Sri Lankans are doing the tough job for CSK. Theekshana knocked over Roy. Pathirana now has Russell holing out. Dhoni puts his arm on Pathirana's shoulder and has a chat with him. This was the slower ball, he hides it away from the reach of Russell. He still has a hack at it and skies it to Dube at deep midwicket. Game over for KKR?
wide yorker, Pathirana nails it this time, squirted to the covers
yorker on middle and leg, dug out towards long-on for a single
overpitched and outside off, Pathirana misses the yorker. Rinku latches onto it and laces it through extra-cover
on a length and floats this slower delivery down the leg side
fullish and on the leg stump, on-pace delivery. Dre Russ stays deep in the crease, gets underneath the length and smites it over wide long-on for six
full-toss on the leg stump, clipped away to the right of long leg. Rasheed, the sub, almost overruns the ball but manages to stop it
full-toss nipping down the leg side. Deshpande has to re-bowl this
short and wide of off, Rinku reaches out for the ball and slices it away to deep point
Flies past Pathirana at short third. Full and wide of off, Rinku carves a thick outside edge past the left of Pathirana
tries the wide yorker, comes out as a full-toss outside off, laced away through extra-cover for four
Deshpande tries the wider yorker, goes too wide. Off-side wide
Rinku shuffles across off, Deshpande goes full and wide. Left alone in the end
forced down to long-on for a single
back of a length and outside off, stabbed through the covers
on a length and veers away outside off to beat the outside edge

Theekshana, you beauty! There's the carrom ball or rather the reverse carrom. And there's the archer celebration. It dips underneath his bat and straightens after pitching to knock over the middle stump. Theekshana is pumped
104.4ks, mighty full on off, Roy sweeps off all lengths. Hits this low full-toss to the right of deep square
hard-length delivery outside off, Roy still clouts it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Another sweep from Roy
just short of a yorker length and outside off, Roy opens the bat-face and carves it away to sweeper cover. Good over from Pathirana, despite that four
slower ball runs away outside off, Rinku opens the face and dinks it to deep third
inswinging yorker on leg stump, top ball from Pathirana, jammed out to fine leg
slower bouncer outside off, Roy plays early and does not connect with ball
back of a length and on off, flat-batted to cover
short and wide, Roy throws his bat at ball and sends a thick outside edge flying fine of deep third. 19-ball half-century for Roy. He has given KKR hope in this steep chase
slings a full-toss down the leg side
tossed up outside off and turning into Rinku who drops down to one knee and pastes a slog-sweep over square leg
back of a length and darted into middle and leg, whisked away through midwicket. Roy jogs across for the single
slapped away to deep point on the back foot
back of a length and turns back in to strike his thigh pad as Rinku goes low and misses the sweep
dragged down outside off, scythed away to deep backward point on the back foot
pushed through full and on middle and leg, bunted down the ground for a single
speared into the top of off stump, Rinku plinks it down to long-on for a single
carrom ball, shorter and just a shade outside off, dragged away to deep midwicket
mowed over wide long-on for six more. Smashed flat and hard. 105ks dart on off stump, Roy stretches out and goes big once again
dropped short and very wide of off stump, Theekshana bowls to his field, slapped away to deep point
darted into a hard length and sliding in at off, splices a sweep in front of deep midwicket
darted on a back of a length on middle, not a bad ball from Theekshana but Roy makes it look bad by hauling it away to the midwicket boundary
Roy threatens to launch into another slog-sweep but Jadeja fires it very full and outside off. Roy opens the bat face and jabs it through point in the end
shortish and angling across off stump, flashed away through the point region on the back foot
Jadeja aims to hide it away from the reach of Rinku by pushing this wide of off. Rinku still reaches out for it and slams it over long-on for six more
pushed through just a shade outside off, Roy shapes for the reverse-sweep and tickles it only as far as short third
dropped short and wide of off, Roy manufactures swinging room and wallops it through extra-cover. KKR need more of these
floated up full on off stump, Roy drops down to one knee once again and mows it over midwicket. Another mighty slog-sweep from Roy
good length and outside off, Roy uses his wrists and drives it away to the right of sweeper cover
off-stump yorker, dug out to point
back of a length and skips away past the outside edge near the shoulder of the bat. Rinku is late onto it and beaten for pace
bumper outside off, Rinku sways out of the way
shorter and wide of off stump, toe-ended into the point region
squirted back to Pathirana
stabbed into the covers

arm ball, 101.1ks, fizzing into middle, chipped back to the bowler. Does not carry to Jadeja who collects it on the bounce and under-arms it onto the stumps through his legs but Rinku is in. The bails don't get dislodged at the non-striker's end. Roy is interested in a single. Rinku isn't. Roy has to undo his steps quickly. He dives and hurts himself once again. Roy reaches his crease by the time Dhoni takes the bails off. Drama at Eden
Rinku now connects with the reverse-sweep and gets it to deep point
Rinku searches for a reverse-sweep and almost drags it back onto his own stumps
prodded into the covers on the front foot
Jadeja has been good against left-handers too this IPL. He has another one holing out. Gaikwad takes it at deep midwicket. Rushes onto Rana outside off. He can only drag the slog-sweep to Gaikwad
darted outside off and angling away from the left-hander, dinked away fine of short third
Roy goes bang bang bang! Tossed up on middle, 94ks, Roy rolls out a reverse-sweep and hits it flat and hard over point
another slog-sweep and another six. This is in fact a bigger hit. Pushed through and turning into middle and leg, Roy goes low and launches it over the leg side
tossed up on off stump, Roy stretches out and nails a slog-sweep over square leg. This was in Roy's slot for the sweep
looped up and breaking away outside off. Rana stretches out and slices it away to deep point
fullish and turning into middle from over the stumps, Roy pushes it down to long-on

and Moeen strikes first ball. The finger goes up. Iyer chats with his captain and asks for a review. Chants of "CSK CSK CSK!" ring around the Eden. Full and sliding in at off from round the stumps. A bit too full for the sweep. Ultra Edge doesn't detect any bat on ball. Flat line as ball passes bat. It would've crashed into middle stump
dug in short and outside off, messes with the pull once again. Iyer splices it over midwicket this time
lifter outside off, splices a hook fine of long leg
Good stop in the deep from Conway. Short and wide, scythed away to the right of the off-side sweeper. Conway throws himself to his right in front of the boundary
on a length and on off, pushed into the covers
kicks up from a back of a length and outside off. Rana stabs and misses
on a length and outside off, Rana shuffles across even before the bowler delivers. He gets inside the line and picks it up over backward square leg
stump-to-stump line, on a length, whisked away towards mid-on. Just five off the over. Terrific stuff from Theekshana
darted wide of off, carved away straight to point
on a hard length and breaks away outside off, another top ball from Theekshana, draws the outside edge and flies to the left of Dhoni and right of short third
speared just a shade outside off, sweeps and misses, narrowly misses off stump
might have been the carrom ball outside off, 101ks, squeezed between point and cover on the front foot
speared down the leg side, wide called
darted on top of off stump, hard length, punched into the covers
short and outside off, not short enough to test Rana. He rolls out a pull and hits the ball over midwicket for four more
Iyer steps out, meets a short ball outside off and forces it through the covers
bouncer outside off, sharp one, Iyer ducks under it
chest-high short ball, angling into the body of Iyer. He gets into position swiftly and hooks it away between long leg and deep midwicket
Iyer backs away outside leg, Akash follows him and keeps him to a dot. Punched more or less straight to point
Akash runs in hard and hits the pitch harder. Iyer flaps at this lifter and wears it on his shoulder. Top-edged onto his shoulder
slower cutter outside off, Rana drives early and misses. Deshpande is a much improved bowler this IPL
back of a length and on off, no room for Rana once again, stabbed back to Deshpande
back of a length and slanted across off stump, forced to point on the back foot
dug in shorter and on off, cramps Rana for room, fended back to the bowler
edged and flies away fine of deep third. On a length and angling across off, Rana throws his bat at ball and slices a thick outside edge
back of a length, starts outside leg and ducks in to strike the thigh pad
Akash hits the splice of Iyer's bat, fended back to him. He can pound the deck as well
bumper outside off, too high and hence that's a wide
too full and on the pads, Iyer uses the inswing and puts it away past short fine leg. Duly picked away to the right of short fine
pitched-up delivery on the stumps, Iyer meets it early by dashing out of the crease. He extends his arms and pumps Akash over his head
full and veering into the pads, Iyer can't get the flick away, the ball brushes the pad and rolls behind to Dhoni
fuller and swinging into the pads, flicked away more or less straight to square leg
shortish and sliding into the top of off stump, hint of inswing for Akash. Forced back to him
pulled flat and hard over square leg. Digs it shorter and outside off, Rana latches onto it and hauls it away over the leg side. Hits the ad cushion on the flush
back of a length and on a fourth-stump line, defensively dropped to short cover
fullish and just a shade outside off, inward movement for Deshpande. Venkatesh throws his bat at ball and ekes out an inside edge onto the pad
full inswinger, having pitched just outside leg, strikes the front pad. Rana gets across for a leg bye

Flashed to square-ish third. Jadeja runs in, slides on his knees, and snags it coolly at deep third. On a length and swings away outside off, Jagadeesan stays leg-side of the ball and slices it in the air. Jadeja makes this catch look ridiculously easy. Deshpande also strikes in his first over
dug into the middle of the deck and messes with Jagadeesan's pull. Flapped weakly to mid-on
Venkatesh steps out to Akash who drags his length back and his outswinger away from the reach of the advancing batter. Another fine start from Akash
on a length, threatens to angle in from left-arm over, but straightens away in the channel. Venkatesh hangs his bat out and is beaten on the outside edge

Swing and a miss. Swing and a miss. Castled next ball. Narine dashes out of the crease, swishes and misses the ball by a long way. Slanting in from left-arm over and pinging the top of off stump. KKR's top-order troubles continue
pitched up and swings away outside off. Narine stays leg-side of the ball. Flashes and misses once again
short of a good length and veers away outside off against the inward angle from left-arm over. Narine has a flat-footed swish and misses
back of a length and on top of off stump, Jagadeesan jabs it to mid-off and gets off the mark immediately
